_note: Selector/flow map for the grok adapter. Data, not code: fix UI drift here.

interstitials._note: Modal announcements Grok puts over the connectors page (seen 2026-10-16: the page behind turns inert, so 'New Connector' has no accessible button and clicks time out). Closed with Escape; the named button is the fallback.

list._note: REQ-D017: a connected row's wrapper says Connected; the chip opens the Manage view; the offer-all button lists every connected app.

detail._note: REQ-D017: a connector's detail (read-only): the tools line, then one button per tool, ended by the expand button; never press a tool.

auth._note: Browser-layer facts: which cookie proves a signed-in session (name or name prefix), which cookies are merged back into the master when a run rotates them (refresh), which hosts hold session state, and which SSO hosts are carried along when seeding.
